reason: My buyers pick from a standard plan library and the cost-plus pass-through means I'd only add a line item if the homeowner agrees to pay, and most won't for a renderings line. I'd also worry it shows finishes or options we won't actually build and sets us up for a dispute.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? What if it shows something we won't build? That's a liability and a change-order headache for me, and I'd be eating the $1,500 if the homeowner won't pay for it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my own plan done for free, accurate down to our real standard finishes and options, and a homeowner or buyer who agrees up front to pay the line item.
